# WordSCR

> WordSCR is an educational platform offering language learning resources, writing guides, and practical text analysis tools for students, professionals, and job seekers.

WordSCR combines interactive learning guides with utility tools like character counters and page calculators, supporting users across language learning, career development, and academic writing. The platform emphasizes expert-reviewed content spanning communication skills, multilingual resources, and workplace preparation.

## Core Tools & Utilities

- [Character Counter](https://wordscr.com/character-counter): Character counter tool for text analysis and word-count conversion
- [Page Count Calculator](https://wordscr.com/page-count): Page count calculator for document length conversion and academic writing formatting

## Career & Professional Development

- [CV & Resume Guide](https://wordscr.com/cv-resume): Resume writing guide covering CV structure, job applications, and career advice
- [Interview Preparation](https://wordscr.com/interview): Interview guide covering communication skills and effective communication techniques
- [Writing for Career Success](https://wordscr.com/writing): Writing guides for letters, creative writing, job applications, and interview preparation

## Language & Communication

- [Language Learning Resources](https://wordscr.com/language): Language learning resources covering multilingual communication and global languages
- [How To Say Guide](https://wordscr.com/how-to-say): Guide to expressions, greetings, and multilingual phrases for cultural communication

## Academic & Test Preparation

- [SAT Preparation & Test Resources](https://wordscr.com/wordscr): SAT preparation and test resources including mock exams and college admissions guidance

## About & Support

- [About WordSCR](https://wordscr.com/about): WordSCR mission and overview of language tools including Jumble Solver and Word Unscrambler
- [Contact Us](https://wordscr.com/contact-us): Contact page with customer support information and feedback channels for WordSCR
